text.tspan: sync theta_minus = theta at step 0 - SAME schedule as vanilla DQN
STEP 1 - SELECTION happens on the Online side
STEP 2 - EVALUATION happens on the FROZEN Target side
STEP 3 - Online also predicts for the CURRENT state s,a
theta keeps updating every step, theta_minus stays FROZEN - unchanged from DQN
counter resets to 0, next C-step window begins - identical schedule to vanilla DQN

svg.text: a_star = argmax over a prime of Q(s_prime, a prime, theta)
send next state s_prime and the index a_star
y = r + gamma times Q_hat(s_prime, a_star, theta_minus)
send state s and action a
Loss = (y minus Q_pred) squared, or Huber
Backprop, update theta EVERY single step
when counter reaches C, HARD RESET theta_minus = theta
